entities.summary: Takashi Hiraide (b. 1950-11-21, Kitakyūshū-shi) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kitakyūshū-shi and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
